# scripts/Showcase/IntruderCombat.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Showcase/IntruderCombat.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

PlayerCombat-compatible threat/defence state for the showcase intruder. IntruderBrain chooses actions.
Ticks blow phases and mirrors GuardRig fields; landed strikes use guards' real take_hit paths.
Incoming damage passes through dodge/parry/guard handling, with signals for defence, movement, hits, and kills.

Base: `Node`. Registered class: `none`.

- `enum Phase { IDLE, WINDUP, CHARGING, STRIKE, RECOVER, DRAWING, KICK, DODGE, STAGGER }` — [Source:23](../../../../../scripts/Showcase/IntruderCombat.gd#L23)
